zd (m).scope: Logged nominal altitude reference. Drives original MPC replay and scores the observed tracking of both flights.

original_mpc_collapse.definition: First altitude sample strictly below the 0-0.5 s measured hover median after the post-baseline measured altitude peak. The diagnostic window includes that sample through the final source row.

limitations: Auxiliary and drive commands contain logged in-flight information. They are conditioning/replay inputs and do not establish autonomous controller prediction.
One reserved low-voltage flight per controller in one vertical maneuver. Both comparisons have already been inspected.
No independently calibrated current channel, protection flag or firmware cutoff timestamp in the pinned exports. Crossing and later altitude loss do not identify a causal shutdown mechanism.
Power/energy agreement checks the internal consistency of published reports. It is not independent energy validation.

source_metadata.source: Community-measured LiPo voltage-vs-SOC charts (intofpv.com LiPo voltage quick chart; usedbytes.com measured discharge profile). OCV curve per cell; sag from pack internal resistance handled separately.
source_metadata.notes: OCV-SOC shape is generic LiPo chemistry behavior. Capacity (22 Ah), mass (5.8 kg) and internal resistance (18 mOhm pack) are TYPICAL values for a 12S 22 Ah 25C-class pack: flagged estimated with wide uncertainty and must be replaced with the specific pack's datasheet/measurements for credible endurance numbers.

source_metadata.source: T-Motor official test report MN.00011 (MN3508 KV380): specifications and load-testing data, DC power supply, static bench
source_metadata.notes: Load table transcribed from datasheet page 3 ('Load Testing Data'); every row is internally consistent (thrust/power matches published efficiency). Internal resistance 205 mOhm is the manufacturer winding measurement. Datasheet note: temperature refers to motor surface at 100% throttle after 10 min run.

source_metadata.source: T-Motor official product page: P80 III (without pin) KV100 — specifications and load-testing data (DC bench, G30*10.5 CF propeller), static bench
source_metadata.notes: Table transcribed from the published load-testing rows; every row verified internally consistent: thrust/power equals the published efficiency AND power equals V*I at the row's measured voltage. Row voltages sag 47.91 -> 47.15 V across the sweep; normalized to 47.9 V nominal (+/-1.6%, absorbed by dataset uncertainty). Torque column published per row (used for the rotor reaction-torque parameter). Internal resistance 45-51 mOhm published; 48 mOhm midpoint used.
